AITAISSA.name: Ait Aissa
AITAISSA.note: Ait Aissa Oubrahim on the RN10 between Tinghir (31.52,-5.53) and Tinjdad (31.34,-4.96): OSM node place=village 31.4793,-5.4136. The API's coordinates for this stop (30.4905,-9.1291) lie in the Souss, 360 km from the Agadir – Errachidia line it is a stop of: this entry overrides them.

TCHIKA.name: Tchika
TCHIKA.note: The stop "Tichka (supra)" of the ma-oncf feed (Supratours' El Argoub – Tichka – Lamhariz coaches), 1.2 km from CTM's Imlili stop and 3 km from the OSM place Tchika (node 3178443261, 23.213,-16.1121). CTM's times Imlili → Tchika 90 min (DAGR100) and Bir Guendouz → Tchika 65 min for 145 km (DAGR101) are timetable oddities, not a position problem.
